caveats.feltryckning: Votes against the party line are counted as recorded. Isolated cases can be feltryckningar (accidental button presses), which the riksdag keeps in the official record and the API reports unchanged.
caveats.kvittning: Frånvarande includes kvittning (pairing), where a member stays out by agreement with a member of the opposing side so the balance is unchanged. The open data does not distinguish kvittning from other absence, so participation is not a measure of diligence and is not ranked.
caveats.map: Coordinates come from a principal-component fit to party lines; axes are statistical summaries of voting patterns, not a left/right or any other named scale. Interpret them through the listed top-loading votes.

map.coordinate_scale: PCA scores and member solutions divided by sqrt(n map votes), so positions are comparable across periods of different length; loadings are the unit-norm PCA vectors
map.member_rule: least squares on the member's own cast map votes; at least 50 required
map.orientation: axis 1 oriented so M scores positive, axis 2 so SD scores positive; signs are a reproducibility convention, axes are not left/right

notes: 2024/25: 4 bulk-archive vote(s) excluded; see votes.json excluded_votes

rules.against_line: cast Ja/Nej/Avstår that differs from the member's party's non-null line (analysis set)
rules.agreement_ja_nej: share of votes, where both lines are Ja or Nej, with identical lines
rules.agreement_three_way: share of votes, where both parties have a line, with identical lines among Ja/Nej/Avstår
rules.participation: share of analysis-set votes the member was seated for on which rost != Frånvarande
rules.party_line: plurality among the party's members voting Ja/Nej/Avstår (Frånvarande excluded); tie -> null and listed in ties; nobody cast -> null and listed in no_cast; parti '-' has no line
